init.title: Polling settings
init.description:
Choose how often PowerManager reads the Sunny Island. Power and forecast selectors are unit-filtered. Energy Dashboard sources are imported below and shown with their readiness status. Set either a market-price entity or a fixed import price.

{energy_dashboard_summary}

data.inverter_profile_count: Number of inverter sources to configure with entity pickers

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between read-only Sunny Island polls.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Optional signed instantaneous net grid exchange in W or kW. Positive means importing from the grid; negative means exporting. Do not also configure the separate import/export fields.
data_description.grid_import_power_entity: Instantaneous grid import power in W or kW (typically OBIS 1.7.0). Configure together with grid export power; do not use the cumulative 1.8.0 energy counter.
data_description.grid_export_power_entity: Instantaneous grid export power in W or kW (typically OBIS 2.7.0). Configure together with grid import power; do not use the cumulative 2.8.0 energy counter.
data_description.pv_power_entity: Instantaneous AC power generated by the PV system in W or kW.
data_description.load_power_entity: Instantaneous total household consumption in W or kW, including every local consumer you want considered by policy simulation. When the Energy Dashboard grid, PV, and battery inputs are fresh, PowerManager offers a derived whole-home load sensor automatically.
data_description.estimate_remaining_load: Estimate energy still needed until local midnight from the whole-home load-power history. The derived PowerManager load sensor is selected automatically when available. Requires Home Assistant Recorder and cannot be used with an explicit remaining-load forecast entity.
data_description.control_ownership_confirmed: Records that you have confirmed PowerManager is the sole active-power owner. This only affects an eligibility indicator; it cannot enable battery writes.
data_description.active_control_enabled: Enables the explicit start_control service only after every commissioning confirmation below passes. It never changes Sunny Island configuration registers.
data_description.active_control_scheduled: Allows matching simulation rules to start bounded sessions. Keep disabled until supervised manual control has passed.
data_description.active_control_single_phase_confirmed: The supported write path is restricted to the confirmed single-phase installation.
data_description.active_control_firmware_confirmed: Confirm the installed firmware, external-setpoint mode, fallback behavior, timeout, and fallback power from the read-only commissioning report.
data_description.active_control_ls_rcd_confirmed: The LS circuit breaker and RCD are the only physical isolation boundary; confirm that a supervised operator can use them before enabling control.
data_description.active_control_telemetry_sources: Comma-separated addresses of verified reporting-only senders (for example a PV inverter). Unknown senders still block control; this list does not identify a controller.
data_description.active_control_max_power_w: Software upper bound for both charge and discharge commands. The existing Sunny Island bounds are not rewritten.
data_description.active_control_max_duration_seconds: Per-session software bound. A session always stops and restores its captured state at the deadline.
data_description.load_forecast_history_days: Number of complete prior same-weekday days to average. If too few exist, recent complete days fill the sample. An estimate is withheld unless Recorder has usable data for every selected day.
data_description.telemetry_max_age: Telemetry older than this is treated as stale and is excluded from policy evaluation.
data_description.price_entity: Current import price with an explicit currency/kWh or currency/MWh unit. Leave empty when using a fixed tariff.
data_description.static_price_per_kwh: Fixed contract import price in EUR per kWh. Leave empty when using a market-price entity. Only one price source can be configured.
data_description.remaining_pv_forecast_entity: One or more remaining-energy forecasts for separate PV arrays or inverters, in Wh, kWh, or MWh. Values are combined only when every selected forecast is fresh (up to two hours old). Use remaining forecasts, not lifetime energy meters.
data_description.remaining_load_forecast_entity: Forecast energy still expected to be consumed during the planning period, in Wh, kWh, or MWh. Use a remaining forecast, not a cumulative meter.
data_description.rules_yaml: Versioned YAML rules. Keep enabled: false for simulation; enabled: true is accepted only with scheduled active control and every commissioning gate.
data_description.inverters_yaml: Advanced YAML list of role-specific inverter entities. Use the entity-picker flow above for sensor ID completion. Sources are read-only and do not enable control.
data_description.inverter_profile_count: Set a number to configure inverter sources with native Home Assistant entity pickers. Leave at zero to use the advanced YAML field.
data_description.predictive_capacity_kwh: Usable battery capacity assumed by the planner.
data_description.predictive_end_soc_percent: Target SoC at the next local midnight; the Sunny Island remains the SoC authority.
data_description.predictive_reserve_soc_percent: Minimum SoC reserve used by the planner.
data_description.predictive_export_capacity_kwh: Forecast energy that can be exported before the planner preserves additional headroom.
data_description.predictive_max_charge_power_w: Upper bound for planner recommendations and scheduled commands.
data_description.predictive_grid_charge_allowed: Allow the shadow planner to recommend grid charging when forecast energy cannot meet the target.
data_description.predictive_control_enabled: Use the forecast planner for scheduled control. It remains gated by active-control commissioning and never permits charging above measured PV surplus.

inverter.title: Inverter source {index}
inverter.description: Select the Home Assistant entities for this inverter. PV generation and household load are separate concepts; configure the load forecast once on the previous page.

data_description.id: Lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens only.
data_description.role: PV is generation-only, battery is storage-only, and hybrid can provide both.
data_description.generation_power_entity: Instantaneous AC generation in W or kW. Required for PV sources.
data_description.battery_power_entity: Signed battery flow in W or kW, with the entity's documented charge/discharge convention.
data_description.remaining_pv_forecast_entity: Remaining PV energy in Wh, kWh, or MWh. This is aggregated across PV sources; household load is configured once.

error.price_source_conflict: Choose either a market-price entity or a fixed import price, not both.
error.invalid_static_price: The fixed import price must be a non-negative number.
error.grid_power_source_conflict: Choose either a signed grid exchange entity or the separate import/export power pair, not both.
error.incomplete_grid_power_pair: Configure both grid import power and grid export power, or leave both empty.
error.load_forecast_source_conflict: Choose either an explicit remaining-load forecast entity or historical load estimation, not both.
error.load_forecast_requires_load_power: Historical load estimation requires a whole-home load power entity.
error.invalid_rules: Rules must declare version: 1. Use enabled: false for simulation, or enable scheduled active control and complete every commissioning confirmation before using enabled: true.
error.invalid_inverters: Inverter sources must be a valid YAML list with unique lowercase IDs and at least one entity per inverter.
error.inverter_source_conflict: Use either the inverter entity-picker flow or the advanced inverter YAML field, not both.
error.invalid_inverter_profile: The inverter profile is incomplete or inconsistent with its selected role.
error.missing_grid_power_entity: Energy Dashboard has no usable instantaneous grid-power sensor. Configure one in the grid power field.
error.missing_load_forecast: Configure a whole-home remaining-load forecast, or enable historical load estimation with a whole-home load-power sensor.
error.missing_inverter_telemetry: One or more Energy Dashboard PV sources has no usable generation sensor. Configure the missing source manually before saving.
error.missing_pv_forecast: The Energy Dashboard has no usable solar forecast for its PV sources. Configure a remaining-PV forecast entity before saving.
error.invalid_predictive_targets: The predictive reserve SoC cannot exceed the end-of-day target.
error.active_control_confirmations_required: Active control requires ownership, single-phase topology, firmware behavior, and LS/RCD procedure confirmations.
error.scheduled_control_requires_enablement: Scheduled control requires active control to be enabled first.
error.predictive_control_requires_scheduled: Predictive scheduled control requires scheduled active control to be enabled first.
error.invalid_telemetry_sources: Reporting-only Speedwire sources must be comma-separated host or IPv4 addresses.

communication_failure.title: Sunny Island communication failure
communication_failure.description: PowerManager cannot read the Sunny Island. The integration remains monitor-only and retries with backoff.

possible_external_controller.title: Possible competing SMA controller detected
possible_external_controller.description: A non-Sunny-Island sender was observed on SMA Speedwire. Do not enable active control until ownership has been confirmed.

unsupported_device.title: Unsupported SMA device
unsupported_device.description: The configured endpoint is not a supported Sunny Island model. PowerManager remains unavailable and cannot control it.

firmware_unavailable.title: Sunny Island firmware identity unavailable
firmware_unavailable.description: The Sunny Island answered firmware registers 30061/30063 with an unavailable or undecodable value. Firmware identity is required for the active-control commissioning gate; keep PowerManager monitor-only until the installed firmware and behavior are confirmed.
